Personality: Thiudamaraz, a prominent figure of the Teutones, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Thiudamaraz owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Teutones. Historical Record: Son of Teutobodaz and Frawjo, of the Teutones, a Germanic house of the Ingwafraujingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
